title: [bug] Facebook 视频发布持续失败：code 6000 / subcode 1363045 "There was a problem uploading your video file"
body:
### Self Checks

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] I have searched for existing issues [search for existing issues](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/issues), including closed ones.
- [ ] I can provide the report in English if needed to help more contributors participate in the discussion.
- [x] Please do not modify this template :) and fill in all the required fields.

### Aitoearn version

zuixing

### Please select your platform

Windows

### Steps to reproduce

### 问题描述

通过 AiToEarn Open API 向 Facebook 主页发布视频，**5 次尝试全部失败**，错误固定不变：

- `code: 6000` / `error_subcode: 1363045` / `is_transient: false`
- `"There was a problem uploading your video file. Please try again with another file."`
- type: `OAuthException`

平台侧报出的错误为：**「上传会话声明的文件大小，和实际上传的数据大小不一致」**
→ 这指向 **创建 Facebook resumable upload session 时声明的 `file_size` 与实际推送字节数不匹配**。

### 已排除的变量（6 项）

1. **换了 4 条视频**，包含一条 **0.11 MB / 6 秒纯色极简测试片** → 全部同样报错
2. **编码已归一化**：`h264 High / yuv420p(tv) / AAC 44.1kHz stereo / +faststart`
3. **删除渠道 + 重新授权 2 次**，会话均 `status: completed`，渠道 `auth-status: status = 1`
4. **更换为全新的 AiToEarn 账号**并重新绑定 → 仍然失败
5. **同一个 Facebook 主页手动上传视频完全正常** → 主页未被限制
6. **我方上传素材已自证一致**：`POST /api/assets/uploadSign` 声明的大小 与 `assets.aitoearn.ai` 远端实际 `Content-Length` **完全相等**，已在 0.15 MB / 11.7 MB / 18.9 MB 三档验证

### 复现步骤

1. `GET /api/v2/channels/accounts/auth/facebook` 完成授权
2. `POST /api/assets/uploadSign` → `PUT uploadUrl` → `POST /api/assets/{id}/confirm` 上传视频
3. `POST /api/v2/channels/publish/flows`，`items[0] = { platform: "facebook", accountId, option: { content_category: "post" } }`
4. 到 `publishTime` 后任务失败，返回上述错误

### 环境信息

- 平台：Facebook Page（`Flutek Hydraulics`，`facebook_1306746235855824`）
- 站点：`https://aitoearn.ai`
- **fbtrace_id**：`AsxzCPpLYCGacbxc6rkzDkV`、`A4RogBgKcsJoChpmgikfpXJ`、`AEm8cQM0H5lrxgRFuqT-tOW`、`AJZKXmQKGEzQwjP9JhkYDHB`

### 期望

请确认是发布通道的 bug 还是需要额外配置；如果是 bug，希望能修复 Facebook resumable upload session 的文件大小记账问题。

谢谢！

### ✔️ Expected Behavior


请确认是发布通道的 bug 还是需要额外配置；如果是 bug，希望能修复 Facebook resumable upload session 的文件大小记账问题。

### ❌ Actual Behavior

过 AiToEarn Open API 向 Facebook 主页发布视频，**5 次尝试全部失败**，错误固定不变：

- `code: 6000` / `error_subcode: 1363045` / `is_transient: false`
- `"There was a problem uploading your video file. Please try again with another file."`
- type: `OAuthException`

平台侧报出的错误为：**「上传会话声明的文件大小，和实际上传的数据大小不一致」**
→ 这指向 **创建 Facebook resumable upload session 时声明的 `file_size` 与实际推送字节数不匹配**。

title: Uses Public Default Authentication Secrets
body:
### Self Checks

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] I have searched for existing issues [search for existing issues](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/issues), including closed ones.
- [x] I can provide the report in English if needed to help more contributors participate in the discussion.
- [x] Please do not modify this template :) and fill in all the required fields.

### Aitoearn version

Commit d3aa8bea5b146a8675607cf0144d891aad3e9683 and earlier versions

### Please select your platform

Mac

### Steps to reproduce

# AiToEarn Uses Public Default Authentication Secrets

## Package

AiToEarn

## Affected versions

Commit `d3aa8bea5b146a8675607cf0144d891aad3e9683` and earlier versions
containing the affected code.

## Patched versions

Unknown.

## Description

### Summary

AiToEarn contains public default values for authentication secrets. The
Electron server uses a static fallback for `AUTH_SECRET` to sign and verify
JWTs. The JWT payload contains `isManager`, and `ManagerGuard` grants manager
access when this claim is true.

The backend configuration also contains a static `internalToken`. The shared
authentication guard accepts this value directly as a Bearer token without
JWT verification or user lookup. Internal controllers protected by
`@Internal()` therefore rely on this publicly known value as their only
authentication factor.

### Details

| Component | File | Issue |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electron server | `project/aitoearn-electron/server/src/auth/auth.module.ts` | Static fallback for `AUTH_SECRET` |
| Electron server | `project/aitoearn-electron/server/src/auth/manager.guard.ts` | Trusts `isManager` after JWT verification |
| Backend services | `project/aitoearn-backend/apps/aitoearn-server/config/config.yaml` | Static `auth.secret` and `auth.internalToken` defaults |
| Shared backend auth | `project/aitoearn-backend/libs/aitoearn-auth/src/aitoearn-auth.guard.ts` | Accepts `internalToken` directly |

### Vulnerable Code

`project/aitoearn-electron/server/src/auth/auth.module.ts`:

```ts
JwtModule.register({
  global: true,
  secret: process.env.AUTH_SECRET || "<public static default redacted>",
  signOptions: { expiresIn: '30d' },
})
```

The application places the manager flag inside the JWT:

```ts
const payload: TokenInfo = {
  phone: tokenInfo.phone,
  id: tokenInfo.id,
  name: tokenInfo.name,
  isManager: tokenInfo.isManager,
};
return this.jwtService.sign(payload);
```

`ManagerGuard` then accepts the authorization decision from the token:

```ts
const payload = await this.jwtService.verifyAsync(token, {
  secret: process.env.AUTH_SECRET,
});

if (!payload.isManager) {
  throw new UnauthorizedException();
}
```

The backend configuration also publishes static authentication values:

```yaml
auth:
  secret: <public static default redacted>
  internalToken: <public static default redacted>
```

The shared guard accepts the internal token without establishing a user:

```ts
if (token === this.options.internalToken) {
  return true;
}
```

### PoC

Run only against a local test deployment.

#### JWT manager authorization

1. Leave `AUTH_SECRET` unset in the Electron server.
2. Create a JWT with the public fallback key and a payload containing
   `isManager: true`.
3. Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to a route protected by
   `@Manager()`, such as the manager creation route.
4. Repeat the test with a unique random `AUTH_SECRET`.

Example token-generation pseudocode:

```js
const token = jwt.sign(
  { id: '<test-id>', isManager: true },
  '<public static default redacted>',
  { expiresIn: '30d' },
);
```

Expected secure result: the forged token is rejected. The affected result is
that the request passes `ManagerGuard` and reaches the manager-only handler.

#### Internal bearer token

1. Start the backend with the checked-in `internalToken` value unchanged.
2. Send that value as a Bearer token to an endpoint protected by `@Internal()`.
3. For example, test the AI draft-generation internal endpoints using a body
   that satisfies the endpoint DTO.
4. Repeat with a newly generated internal token.

Expected secure result: an external request without an explicitly authorized
service credential is rejected. The affected result is that the static token
passes the guard without JWT verification, API-key resolution, or user lookup.

### Attack Scenario

- An attacker reads the public repository and obtains the default values.
- The deployment does not override the corresponding environment/configuration
  values.
- The attacker signs a JWT with `isManager: true`, or sends the default
  `internalToken` as a Bearer token.
- The server accepts the token as an authenticated manager or internal caller.

## Impact

The Electron JWT fallback may allow unauthorized access to manager-only
handlers, including manager administration operations. The backend
`internalToken` may allow unauthorized access to internal service endpoints,
including operations that accept a caller-supplied `userId`.

The backend `auth.secret` path additionally uses the token `id` to resolve an
open user record. Its exact impact should be verified against the deployed
token-issuing path, but the checked-in value is not suitable as a production
JWT secret.

## Recommended Fix

1. Remove all static authentication fallbacks from source-controlled
   configuration.
2. Fail closed when `AUTH_SECRET`, `auth.secret`, or `internalToken` is absent
   or unchanged from a development value.
3. Generate instance-specific cryptographically random secrets during secure
   deployment and store them outside the repository.
4. Replace the exposed values and invalidate tokens issued with them.
5. Do not use a bearer string as an implicit internal identity; authenticate
   service callers with scoped, rotatable credentials and enforce service-side
   authorization.
6. Add regression tests proving that default or missing secrets cannot start a
   production deployment and that forged manager/internal requests are
   rejected.

## References

- [JWT fallback in the Electron server](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/blob/d3aa8bea5b146a8675607cf0144d891aad3e9683/project/aitoearn-electron/server/src/auth/auth.module.ts#L16-L20)
- [JWT manager authorization](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/blob/d3aa8bea5b146a8675607cf0144d891aad3e9683/project/aitoearn-electron/server/src/auth/manager.guard.ts#L47-L56)
- [JWT payload construction](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/blob/d3aa8bea5b146a8675607cf0144d891aad3e9683/project/aitoearn-electron/server/src/auth/auth.service.ts#L19-L27)
- [Manager-only handlers](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/blob/d3aa8bea5b146a8675607cf0144d891aad3e9683/project/aitoearn-electron/server/src/manager/manager.controller.ts#L52-L68)
- [Backend authentication defaults](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/blob/d3aa8bea5b146a8675607cf0144d891aad3e9683/project/aitoearn-backend/apps/aitoearn-server/config/config.yaml#L12-L15)
- [Direct internal-token acceptance](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/blob/d3aa8bea5b146a8675607cf0144d891aad3e9683/project/aitoearn-backend/libs/aitoearn-auth/src/aitoearn-auth.guard.ts#L28-L40)
- [Internal AI endpoints](https://github.com/yikart/AiToEarn/blob/d3aa8bea5b146a8675607cf0144d891aad3e9683/project/aitoearn-backend/apps/aitoearn-ai/src/core/internal/draft-generation.controller.ts)


### ✔️ Expected Behavior

...

### ❌ Actual Behavior

title: fix(facebook): raise outdated 90s Reels duration cap
body:
## Problem

Publishing a Facebook **Reel** with a video longer than 90 seconds is rejected at validation with `invalid_duration` ("Video duration must be between 3 and 90 seconds").

Meta **removed the length restriction on Facebook Reels in June 2025** — Facebook videos are now published as Reels with no length/format caps, and current specs document Reels of up to ~60 minutes. The hard-coded 90s cap predates that change and now blocks valid longer Reels. In practice, longer-than-90s Reels publish fine through the `/{page-id}/video_reels` API.

## Root cause

`FACEBOOK_REEL_MEDIA_RULES.maxVideoDuration` is `90` in `facebook-publish.provider.ts` (and the served metadata `mediaRules.maxVideoDuration` in `facebook.constants.ts`). `media.service.ts` validates the probed duration against it and raises `InvalidDuration`, so the request never reaches Facebook.

## Change

- Raise the Facebook **Reel** `maxVideoDuration` from `90` → `3600` (60 min) to match Facebook's current Reels limit.
- Update the served `mediaRules.maxVideoDuration` metadata to match.
- Update the provider spec assertion.

Note: the feed-post path (`content_category: post`) already has **no** duration cap, so this also makes Reel vs. Post consistent. The exact ceiling is open to maintainers' preference — the point is that `90` is outdated post-June-2025.

title: [FR] B站发布编辑框增加「添加水印」开关（与B站网页版一致）
body:
### 1. 遇到的问题 / 使用场景

通过 AiToEarn 网页端发布作品到 B 站（哔哩哔哩）时，B 站编辑框目前只有四项设置：**标题**、**分区**、**类型**（原创/转载）、**是否允许转载**。

而 B 站官方网页版上传视频时，「更多设置」里有 **添加水印** 开关（可勾选「开启」，仅对此次上传的视频生效）。

结果就是：直接通过 B 站网页版发布的视频可以开启水印，通过 AiToEarn 发布的视频则没有这个能力，两个渠道的行为不一致。

### 2. 补充说明

**期望行为**：在 AiToEarn 的 B 站编辑框中增加「添加水印」开关选项，行为与 B 站网页版一致（仅对本次上传的视频生效）。

对比截图：

1. B 站网页版上传页（橙色框标注的即是「添加水印」开关）：
![bilibili-web-watermark-toggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linfeng961/hermes-agent/issue-img-aitoearn-watermark/bilibili-web-watermark-toggle.jpg)

title: fix(tiktok): prevent duplicate posts after retryable failures
body:
# Pull Request

## 🧩 Issue Link

Fixes #586

## 📝 Description

TikTok Direct Post tasks no longer repeat a remote publish operation after AiToEarn has received and saved its `publish_id`. The provider checkpoints that ID before upload or follow-up work. A later failure now enters status reconciliation instead of returning to publish initialization, including credential-refresh re-entry.

TikTok also disables automatic retries for ambiguous failures that happen before a checkpoint. This favors a visible failed task over a possible duplicate public post. If TikTok reports multiple public post IDs, AiToEarn keeps the first post as canonical and retains every reported ID for incident diagnosis.

## ✅ Validation

- 69 focused TikTok, publish-task, queue, and state tests passed.
- Changed-file ESLint passed.
- `aitoearn-server` and all 15 build dependencies compiled successfully.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Repository-wide lint still reports pre-existing errors in `config/config.yaml` and `relay-exception.filter.ts`; neither file is changed by this PR.

## 🚀 Deployment note

The fix affects hosted Relay traffic only after the `aitoearn.ai` backend deploys this change.

title: TikTok Direct Post can duplicate posts after ambiguous retries
body:
## Bug

TikTok Direct Post tasks can create more than one public post when a transient failure occurs after TikTok has accepted the publish request but before AiToEarn persists the returned `publish_id`.

## Failure sequence

1. AiToEarn calls TikTok's Direct Post initialization endpoint.
2. TikTok creates the publish operation and returns a `publish_id`.
3. The upload or local persistence path fails.
4. The task is treated as retryable and returns to the publish queue.
5. The retry initializes a second TikTok publish operation for the same task.

An ambiguous timeout during initialization has the same risk because the client cannot know whether TikTok accepted the request.

## Expected behavior

- Persist `publish_id` before any upload or follow-up work.
- After a remote checkpoint exists, reconcile status instead of calling Direct Post initialization again.
- Do not automatically retry ambiguous TikTok publish-init failures.
- If TikTok reports multiple public post IDs for one `publish_id`, preserve the first canonical ID and retain all IDs for incident diagnosis.

## Validation

A patch with focused regression tests is ready. It covers the checkpoint-before-upload sequence, credential-refresh re-entry, disabled ambiguous retries, reconciliation after checkpointed failures, and multiple public post IDs.

title: [Bug] 快手和哔哩哔哩发布必然失败：content.cover media_unreachable（封面 URL 公开可访问；之前正常）
body:
### 自查清单
- [x] 我已阅读贡献指南。
- [x] 我已搜索过已有问题（包括已关闭的）。
- [x] 我可以用英文提供报告（如需）。
- [x] 请勿修改此模板 :) 并填写所有必填字段。

### Aitoearn 版本
Web 端（aitoearn.cn，中文站），2026-08-08

### 请选择你的平台
- [x] Windows
- [x] Web

### 复现步骤

1. 打开 https://aitoearn.cn/zh-CN/publish → 新建作品
2. 上传 MP4 视频（试过 HEVC/H.265 原片 和 H.264 重新转码两种，24 秒，约 2MB）
3. 填写标题、带话题的描述（#鹦鹉 #宠物 #动物趣事）
4. 点「下一步」→ 在确认页**只勾选快手 和 哔哩哔哩**（取消其他平台）
5. 填写各平台要求：快手描述、B站分区（动物圈/小宠异宠）、允许转载、封面（也试过通过「裁剪封面」设置全局封面，以及完全不设置封面）
6. 点击「发布」

**结果：无论怎么配置，快手和哔哩哔哩都必然失败，提示「发布内容校验失败」。**

失败弹窗和提示截图：

![publish-failure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linfeng961/hermes-agent/issue-img-aitoearn/aitoearn_publish_fail.jpg)

顶部提示条显示：`KWAI / content.cover: 封面无法访问或解析失败，请检查链接是否可公开访问`

### ✔️ 预期行为
快手和哔哩哔哩的发布任务应该成功创建，就像之前一样（此前用 AiToEarn 发布视频到各平台都正常，2026-08-07 同一账号发布到快手、哔哩哔哩、小红书、微信视频号等多个平台均无问题）。

### ❌ 实际行为
发布接口 `POST /api/v2/channels/publish/flows` 返回 `code: 15051`：

```json
{
  "data": {
    "platform": "KWAI",
    "accountId": "KWAI_f1b6d99b9252a17314bf5724bfb0c1d1",
    "issues": [{
      "code": "media_unreachable",
      "path": ["content", "cover"],
      "params": {
        "field": "cover",
        "url": "https://assets.aitoearn.cn/6a61b04ea113b7e4b7a4da83/user/media/202608/v7ZMTATyp7nnoSe5zU1gM.jpg"
      },
      "message": "封面无法访问或解析失败，请检查链接是否可公开访问"
    }]
  },
  "code": 15051,
  "message": "发布内容校验失败"
}
```

**关键观察：**

1. **尝试了 4 种不同配置，全部以相同方式失败：**
   - HEVC 原片 + 不设封面 → 失败
   - H.264 转码 + 全局封面（裁剪封面）→ 失败
   - H.264 + 在快手/B站平台行内单独设置封面 → 失败
   - H.264 + 确认封面已生成后再发布 → 失败
   - 发布前所有「问题」警告都已清除，没有任何表单未完成提示

2. **封面 URL 从外部完全可公开访问**：我用 curl 测试了 `https://assets.aitoearn.cn/6a61b04ea113b7e4b7a4da83/user/media/202608/v7ZMTATyp7nnoSe5zU1gM.jpg` — HTTP 200，Content-Type: image/jpeg，约 187KB，是有效 JPEG。也测试了带 `Referer: https://kwai.com/` 和 `Referer: https://bilibili.com/` — 均返回 HTTP 200。也就是说从任何我们能测试的网络角度，这个链接都是可达的。

3. **只有走服务端任务模式的平台受影响**：同一流程中，小红书和微信视频号（浏览器插件路径）**发布成功**。只有快手和哔哩哔哩（走服务端发布任务）在服务端内容校验环节失败。

4. **之前是正常的**：2026-08-07 用同一账号发布到包括快手和哔哩哔哩在内的所有平台都没有问题。2026-08-08 开始失败，期间账号和文件没有任何改动。这看起来像是**服务端回归**（可能是封面 URL 校验逻辑，或校验服务访问 OSS 的问题）。

请检查快手/B站发布流程中 `content.cover` 的服务端校验逻辑——封面 URL 是公开可访问的，校验服务本身可能无法访问 `assets.aitoearn.cn`，或者封面生成在校验执行前尚未完成。

title: 微信视频号授权频繁掉线，一天内需多次重新登录
body:
### 问题描述

微信视频号授权后**掉线非常频繁**，通常不到一天就需要重新扫码登录，多次实测（2026-08）：
- 早上授权 → 当天晚上发布时就显示「已离线」
- 发布面板中视频号账号头像变半透明，平台行直接消失
- 需要重新走「频道管理 → 重新授权 → 扫码」才能恢复

这个和 #19（2025-07-28 反馈，官方回复「暂时没办法」）是同一问题，至今仍未解决，想确认：
1. 这是微信侧 OAuth/cookie 有效期限制，还是插件侧会话保持问题？
2. 是否有计划延长授权有效期，或自动刷新机制？
3. 其他平台（快手/B站/小红书）没有这个问题，只有视频号这样，是否有绕开方案？

### 环境
- Windows 10 + Chrome 扩展方式接入

Self-hosted Docker Compose; public main 3cbb97bb9a58dd99b97f45b60923cdbfdfeb3368; images pulled 2026-07-27

Web

### Steps to reproduce

1. Deploy AiToEarn with the official Docker Compose configuration from public main (commit 3cbb97bb9a58dd99b97f45b60923cdbfdfeb3368).
2. Configure a valid China Server Relay API key and use the China relay.
3. Open the self-hosted Channel Manager and start Douyin QR authorization.
4. Scan the QR code and explicitly confirm authorization in the Douyin mobile app.
5. Continue polling until the relay reports code 0, message "request succeeded", status "completed", and requiresSelection false.
6. Refresh Channel Manager and inspect the local account records.

I also repeated the flow with a temporary HTTPS callback-only tunnel. No credentials, account IDs, callback host, or session data are included in this report.

### ✔️ Expected Behavior

After relay status becomes completed, the relay should deliver the authorized account to the self-hosted callback endpoint. The local server should create the channel account, persist its authorization identity and credential, and show one connected Douyin channel in Channel Manager.

### ❌ Actual Behavior

The relay status reaches completed, but the self-hosted server receives no callback request and creates no local channel. Channel Manager returns to its main view with zero channels. MongoDB remains empty for account, channelAuthIdentity, and oauth2Credential records. All Docker containers stay healthy. The HTTPS callback isolation test also received zero callback requests after two explicit Douyin confirmations.

title: fix(subtitle-mcp): validate mediaUrl scheme before FFmpeg to prevent protocol/argument injection
body:
Closes #579

## Vulnerability

The `generateSubtitle` MCP tool in `project/aitoearn-backend/apps/aitoearn-ai/src/core/agent/mcp/subtitle.mcp.ts` forwards a caller-controlled `mediaUrl` straight into `ffmpeg -i` without checking the URL scheme. FFmpeg speaks many protocols beyond `http(s)` — `file:`, `concat:`, `subfile:`, `data:`, `pipe:`, `rtmp:`, `gopher:`, `srtp:`, … — so an authenticated MCP caller (or a prompt-injectable LLM/agent connected to the MCP server) can turn the tool into an arbitrary local file reader and an SSRF gateway, and can also inject FFmpeg CLI flags via a leading `-`.

- **CWE**: CWE-78 (argument injection into an external program), CWE-918 (SSRF), CWE-22 (arbitrary file read)
- **Sink**: `execa('ffmpeg', ['-i', mediaUrl, ...])` in `extractAudioWithFFmpeg`
- **Source**: `mediaUrl` from the `generateSubtitle` MCP tool. `generateSubtitleSchema` declares `mediaUrl: z.string()`, which does not constrain the scheme.

The value flows unchanged from the MCP tool handler → `extractAudioWithFFmpeg(mediaUrl)` → `execa('ffmpeg', ['-i', mediaUrl, ...])`. `execa` avoids a shell, so this is not classic shell injection — but FFmpeg itself dispatches on the URL scheme and treats a leading `-` as a flag.

## Fix

Two commits' worth of change squashed into one small diff (`+39 lines`, single file):

1. New helper `assertSafeMediaUrl(mediaUrl)`:
   - Parses via `new URL(...)` and requires `protocol === 'http:' || 'https:'`.
   - Rejects values starting with `-` (defence against argument injection).
2. Called both from the tool handler (so the caller gets a clean error) and from `extractAudioWithFFmpeg` (so the check cannot be bypassed by any future caller of that private method).
3. Adds `-protocol_whitelist https,http,tls,tcp` to the FFmpeg argv as defence-in-depth against protocol chaining inside playlists/HLS segments that FFmpeg would otherwise follow into `file:` or `concat:`.

Rationale: the tool is documented as taking a media URL, so restricting to http(s) matches its intended contract. `-protocol_whitelist` is FFmpeg's own supported mechanism for exactly this class of issue, and layering both gives us protection even if a future refactor loses the JS-level check.

## Proof of concept

Against the pre-fix code, any caller that can reach the MCP tool can invoke:

```json
{
  "name": "generateSubtitle",
  "arguments": {
    "mediaUrl": "file:///etc/passwd",
    "language": "en"
  }
}
```

FFmpeg opens `/etc/passwd` as input. Other payloads that reproduce the same class of bug pre-fix:

- `concat:/etc/hosts|/etc/passwd` — concatenate local files as the audio input
- `subfile,,start,0,end,4096,,:/etc/shadow` — byte-range read of a local file
- `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` — SSRF to cloud metadata
- `gopher://internal-service:6379/_...` — SSRF against internal Redis/etc.
- `-y` or `-loglevel debug` as the value of `mediaUrl` — argument injection into the FFmpeg command line

After the fix, every one of these is rejected before FFmpeg is spawned with `Invalid mediaUrl protocol "…"` / `Invalid mediaUrl: must not start with "-"`, and even if a future code path skipped `assertSafeMediaUrl`, `-protocol_whitelist https,http,tls,tcp` would still block `file:`/`concat:`/`subfile:`/`gopher:`/`data:`/`pipe:`.

## Testing

- Verified statically that both call sites (`extractAudioWithFFmpeg` and the tool handler at the `generateSubtitleSchema.shape` registration) now pass through `assertSafeMediaUrl`.
- Manually walked the URL parser: `new URL('file:///etc/passwd').protocol === 'file:'`, `new URL('concat:a|b').protocol === 'concat:'`, `new URL('http://x/').protocol === 'http:'` — the check correctly accepts only `http:`/`https:`.
- Confirmed leading-dash guard by checking that `new URL('-y')` throws (so it's rejected at the parse step too, but the explicit dash guard is retained for clarity and to defend against any downstream code that ever accepts non-URL strings).
- Diff scope confirmed minimal: `git diff origin/main..HEAD --stat` → `1 file changed, 39 insertions(+)`.

## Adversarial review

Before submitting, we tried to disprove this finding. Considered:

- **Is the endpoint already gated in a way that makes it a non-issue?** The MCP server is designed to be attached to LLM agents / Cursor / Claude Desktop per the project README. Any user who wires it up is a valid caller, and prompt injection against those agents is a realistic threat model — this isn't an "attacker already has RCE" situation.
- **Does `execa` (no-shell) already prevent this?** No. `execa` prevents shell metacharacter injection, but the vulnerability is inside FFmpeg's own URL-protocol dispatcher, which runs regardless of how the argv was constructed.
- **Does the Zod schema constrain the URL?** No — `z.string()` accepts any string, including `file:///…` and `-y`.
- **Is `-protocol_whitelist` alone sufficient?** It closes the FFmpeg-side attack surface but not the leading-`-` argument-injection case, and it also allows attackers to still pass e.g. `http://internal/` SSRF. The URL-parse check is what enforces http(s) semantics; `-protocol_whitelist` is the belt to that suspenders.

We couldn't find a mitigation already in the codebase that would prevent exploitation, so the fix is warranted.

title: Security: argument/protocol injection into FFmpeg via generateSubtitle MCP mediaUrl (CWE-78 / CWE-918)
body:
## Summary

The `generateSubtitle` MCP tool in `apps/aitoearn-ai/src/core/agent/mcp/subtitle.mcp.ts` passes a caller-supplied `mediaUrl` directly to `ffmpeg -i` without validating the URL scheme. Because FFmpeg accepts many protocols beyond `http(s)` (`file:`, `concat:`, `subfile:`, `data:`, `pipe:`, `rtmp:`, `gopher:`, …), any authenticated MCP caller — including an LLM/agent that a user has connected via the MCP server — can coerce the server to read arbitrary local files, perform SSRF against internal services, or inject FFmpeg CLI flags.

- **CWE**: CWE-78 (argument injection into an external program) / CWE-918 (SSRF) / CWE-22 (arbitrary file read)
- **File**: `project/aitoearn-backend/apps/aitoearn-ai/src/core/agent/mcp/subtitle.mcp.ts`
- **Sink**: `execa('ffmpeg', ['-i', mediaUrl, ...])` inside `extractAudioWithFFmpeg`
- **Source**: `mediaUrl` argument of the `generateSubtitle` MCP tool (Zod-validated as `z.string()`, no scheme constraint)

## Data flow

1. MCP tool `generateSubtitle` is registered with `generateSubtitleSchema = z.object({ mediaUrl: z.string(), language: z.string().optional() })` — `z.string()` does not restrict the URL scheme.
2. The handler forwards `mediaUrl` unchanged into `extractAudioWithFFmpeg(mediaUrl)`.
3. `extractAudioWithFFmpeg` calls `execa('ffmpeg', ['-i', mediaUrl, ...])`. `execa` avoids a shell (so this is not classic shell injection), but FFmpeg itself parses the URL and dispatches to a protocol handler (`file`, `concat`, `data`, `subfile`, `rtmp`, `gopher`, `pipe`, `srtp`, …). A leading `-` in `mediaUrl` is additionally parsed by FFmpeg as a flag.

## Proof of concept

Any caller that can reach the MCP tool can invoke it with:

```json
{
  "name": "generateSubtitle",
  "arguments": {
    "mediaUrl": "file:///etc/passwd",
    "language": "en"
  }
}
```

FFmpeg opens `/etc/passwd` (or any readable file on the server) as an input. Equivalent payloads that all reproduce against the pre-fix code:

- `concat:/etc/hosts|/etc/passwd` — read+concatenate local files
- `subfile,,start,0,end,4096,,:/etc/shadow` — byte-range read of a local file
- `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` — SSRF to cloud metadata
- `gopher://internal-service:6379/_...` — SSRF against internal Redis/etc.
- `-y` or `-loglevel debug` as the value of `mediaUrl` — argument injection into the FFmpeg command line

FFmpeg output feeds the transcription pipeline; even without direct output, error messages and blind/timing side channels are typically enough to exfiltrate contents (and `concat:` frequently returns file bytes verbatim to the audio stage).

## Fix

Validate `mediaUrl` before it ever reaches FFmpeg:

1. Parse with `new URL(mediaUrl)` and require `protocol === 'http:' || 'https:'`.
2. Reject any value starting with `-` (defence against argument injection).
3. Additionally pass `-protocol_whitelist https,http,tls,tcp` to FFmpeg as defence-in-depth against protocol chaining inside playlists/HLS segments FFmpeg might follow.

Both `extractAudioWithFFmpeg` and the tool entry point call the validator so the check cannot be bypassed by future callers.

A PR with the fix will follow this issue: it adds an `assertSafeMediaUrl` helper and the `-protocol_whitelist` flag. The diff is a single file, +39 lines.

## Preconditions & impact

- Requires the ability to invoke the `generateSubtitle` MCP tool (authenticated MCP/agent user, or a prompt-injectable LLM connected to the server).
- Does **not** require any pre-existing local-file-read capability on the host — this fix closes a real capability gap rather than duplicating existing access.
- Impact: arbitrary local file read on the `aitoearn-ai` container, SSRF into the internal network (including cloud metadata endpoints), and potential FFmpeg-flag injection.

title: BUG: AiToEarn Extension 无法检测小红书登录状态（已登录但插件显示未登录）
body:
## Bug 描述

Chrome 插件「AiToEarn Extension」无法正确检测小红书（xiaohongshu.com）的登录状态。

**现状：** 用户已在小红书网页端（www.xiaohongshu.com）正常登录，可以正常浏览个人主页和个人资料，但插件弹窗中始终显示：

> "小红书未登录，请先在插件中登录"

插件详情页显示：
- 小红书卡片状态：**"仅创作者中心已登录"**
- 警告信息：**"已登录小红书创作者中心，但暂时无法抓取笔记详情，请前往小红书主页登录"**

## 复现步骤

1. 在 Chrome/Cent Browser 中正常登录小红书（www.xiaohongshu.com）
2. 已登录状态下正常访问个人主页（如 user/profile/xxx）
3. 打开 AiToEarn Extension 插件侧边栏或弹窗
4. 观察小红书账号状态

**预期行为：** 插件应正确检测到用户已在 xiaohongshu.com 登录，状态显示为"已连接"

**实际行为：** 插件只识别到"创作者中心"的登录态，未能识别普通网站页面的登录态，导致认为"未登录"

## 影响

- 小红书作为核心平台之一，无法正常使用插件的发布功能
- 用户需要同时在创作者中心和普通主页之间反复切换登录，体验割裂
- 从截图看到小红书普通主页和创作者中心是两个独立域名（www.xiaohongshu.com vs creator.xiaohongshu.com），插件可能只检测了后者

## 环境

- 浏览器：Cent Browser（Chromium）
- AiToEarn Extension 版本：3.2.10
- 小红书账号：已正常登录，粉丝 0，笔记 0
- 操作系统：Windows 10

## 截图说明

插件弹窗中：
- 小红书卡片：橙底白字警告，显示"仅创作者中心已登录"
- 视频号卡片：绿底白字，显示"已连接"（正常）
- 顶部黄色通知条："小红书未登录，请先在插件中登录"

## 推测原因

小红书有多个子域名：
- `www.xiaohongshu.com` — 普通用户主页/浏览
- `creator.xiaohongshu.com` — 创作者中心
- `edith.xiaohongshu.com` — 内容编辑

插件可能只检测了 `creator.xiaohongshu.com` 域下的 Cookie/登录态，而忽略了 `www.xiaohongshu.com` 域。建议插件检测时同时覆盖 `www.xiaohongshu.com` 的登录状态，或者在用户已登录 `www` 域的情况下引导/自动同步到 `creator` 域。

title: BUG: 发布作品页面的话题输入框（#）点击无响应，无法输入话题
body:
## Bug 描述

在「多平台矩阵发布 → 发布作品」页面中，话题输入框（带 `#` 前缀的输入区域）点击后没有任何反应，无法聚焦也无法输入文字。

## 复现步骤

1. 打开 `aitoearn.cn/zh-CN/accounts`（发布作品页面）
2. 选择一个平台账号（如 B站 momononame）
3. 填写标题和描述
4. 点击标题下方的话题输入框（提示文字“输入 # 可设置话题”）

**预期行为：** 输入框聚焦，光标闪烁，可输入话题标签并按回车添加

**实际行为：** 点击输入框无任何反应，无法聚焦，无法输入

## 影响范围

- B站发布时「话题是必须的」，该输入框无法使用导致 B站发布流程卡住
- 其他平台也依赖话题功能

## 截图

截图显示话题输入框带有橙色警告边框（验证状态），但点击无效，发布按钮仍可点击进入下一步。

## 环境

- 浏览器：Cent Browser (Chromium)
- 页面：`https://aitoearn.cn/zh-CN/accounts`
- 操作：已选中视频、已填写标题（14/16 字符），话题输入框无法输入

## 推测

可能是输入框的 `contentEditable` 或 `onClick` 事件绑定异常，或与编辑器区域的焦点管理冲突。我注意到编辑器（mention-input-editor）和话题输入框可能共享同一个焦点上下文，导致话题输入框无法独立获取焦点。

title: MCP: 增加 listAccounts 工具，返回用户已连接的平台账号列表
body:
## 需求描述

MCP Server 目前提供了 `createChannelPublishFlow` 等发布工具，但在调用这些工具时需要一个关键参数——`accountId`（用户在各平台已授权账号的内部 ID）。然而当前 MCP 工具集中**没有任何一个工具能返回已连接账号的列表**，导致 AI Agent 无法自主完成发布流程。

## 当前状态

现有的账号相关工具有：

| 工具 | 功能 | 是否返回账号列表 |
|------|------|:---:|
| `listChannelWorks(platform, accountId)` | 查询指定账号的作品列表 | ❌ 需要 accountId 才能查 |
| `listChannelPosts(platform, uid)` | 查询指定平台账号的帖子 | ❌ 需要 uid 才能查 |
| `getChannelAccountAnalytics(accountId)` | 账号数据分析 | ❌ 需要 accountId 才能查 |
| `listChannelPublishRecords` | 发布记录列表 | ❌ 返回发布记录，不含账号信息 |
| `getMyProfile` | 用户信息 | ❌ 只返回 AiToEarn 用户 ID |

可以看到，没有一个工具能从「用户→已连接平台账号」这个方向给出数据。

## 具体需求

增加一个 MCP 工具，例如 `listAccounts` 或 `getAccounts`，返回用户已授权/已连接的所有平台账号列表，每个账号应包含：

```json
{
  "accountId": "6a61b04ea113b7e4b7a4da8x",
  "platform": "KWAI",
  "platformName": "快手",
  "accountName": "一只魔法喵",
  "status": "online",
  "followerCount": 3,
  "avatar": "https://..."
}
```

## 为什么重要

1. **AI Agent 自主发布** — AI 需要先知道用户有哪些账号，才能选择发布目标。现在缺了这个信息，AI 只能让用户手动去网页端复制 ID。
2. **跨平台管理** — 用户可能有多个平台账号，需要编程查询哪些是在线的、哪些有问题。
3. **MCP 全链路闭环** — 从查询账号 → 填写内容 → 发布 → 查看结果，现在的链路缺了第一环。

## 可选扩展

如果能同时支持按平台筛选（`listAccounts(platform: "xhs")`），体验会更好。

## 使用场景示例（我的场景）

我正在通过 Hermes Agent + MCP 使用 AiToEarn。我想对 AI 说"把这段视频发到我已连接的所有平台"，AI 应该能：
1. 调用 `listAccounts` 获取账号列表 → 2. 调用 `createChannelPublishFlow` 同时发布

而不是：
1. 让用户去网页端查 ID → 2. 手动告诉我 → 3. 我再填进去

---

## 变更概述

基于 OPTIMIZATION_PLAN.md 第②项，在 Engage Agent 中新增养号状态机 + LLM 意图分类模块。

## 新增文件

### core/nurture/ 模块
- **account-state.ts** — 养号状态机核心：COLD→WARM→HOT→ACTIVE 四阶段状态管理
- **intent-classifier.ts** — 评论意图分类器：内置规则引擎 + LLM 兜底
- **nurture.module.ts** — NestJS 模块注册
- **index.ts** — 统一导出

### 测试
- **account-state.spec.ts** — 28 个测试：阶段推断、配置表、动作检查、配额消耗、状态转移、每日重置
- **intent-classifier.spec.ts** — 15 个测试：高/低/无效关键词匹配、边界情况

**共 43 个测试全部通过 ✅**

## 集成改动

- channels.module.ts — 导入 NurtureModule.register()
- engagement.service.ts — 构造函数注入 IntentClassifier + ServerRedisService
- server-redis-keys.ts — 新增 nurture 相关 Redis key

## 状态机设计

```
COLD (1-3天) → WARM (4-7天) → HOT (8-14天) → ACTIVE (15天+)
  - 禁止发布    每日1条     每日3条     每日5条
  - 20互动/日   15互动/日   10互动/日   10互动/日
  - 5评论/日    5评论/日    3评论/日    5评论/日
```

## 意图分类设计

```
评论 → 内置规则快速匹配 → 无法确定 → LLM 精细分类
  ├── HIGH (高意向) → 触发私信
  ├── MEDIUM (中意向) → 仅回评
  └── INVALID (无效) → 忽略
```

## 验证

- vitest — 43/43 通过
- tsc --noEmit — 无新增编译错误

title: feat(core): dedup scoring + re-mix trigger
body:
## 变更概述

在 Create Agent 的混剪管线后插入一层"去重评分 + 二次混剪触发器"。

### 新增 `core/dedup/` 模块

**三个子评分器：**

| 评分器 | 方法 |
|--------|------|
| 帧级 pHash | 利用 `sharp` 对关键帧计算感知哈希，与源库比对 |
| 音频频谱指纹 | 64-bin 频谱特征，余弦相似度比对 |
| 字幕 embedding | 优先 OpenAI API，fallback 确定性模拟 |

**综合评分：**
- 默认权重：帧 0.4 / 音频 0.3 / 字幕 0.3
- 阈值 0.7：低于放行，≥0.7 触发二次混剪

**二次混剪触发器（RemixWrapper）：**
- 变速 0.95x~1.05x（随机）
- 抽帧 5%
- 位置偏移 ±2px
- 噪点 LUT 层（强度 0.02）
- 委托给现有 Volcengine DirectEdit 服务

### 测试
- 43 个 vitest 用例，全部通过
- 覆盖 frame-scorer / audio-scorer / subtitle-scorer / composite-scorer / remix-wrapper

- `apps/aitoearn-ai/src/core/dedup/` — 13 个新文件（1673 行）
